title: did-rollup-registry-artifact: event-based vs storage-based DID registries on Ethereum rollups
description: Contracts, measurement scripts, raw measurement data, analysis and figure scripts, and the on-chain transaction trail for the paper 'Anchoring Decentralized Identifiers on Ethereum Rollups: A Gas-Level Comparison of Event-Based and Storage-Based Registry Designs' (IEEE INDICON 2026).
